coverage_notes: Exactly 12 bounded targeted web searches were completed across sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry/food-bank service reductions, and SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruptions. No new qualifying U.S. disruption was identified in the hourly window. Fresh relevant results were non-qualifying or outside the window, including Kaua'i recovery distributions proceeding as scheduled and older grocery/pantry closure stories. Donation drives, resource guides, routine program promotion, generic inflation coverage, opinion, non-U.S. items, and duplicates were excluded.
